objective: Isolate corrected measured-encoder actor sensing under unchanged SpiderWalk stance, reference, reward, actuation and fallback policy.
source_pin: Exact reviewed and pushed implementation commit must be supplied before execution; never fetch or change source while workers remain active.

initial_checkpoint.historical_encoder_mode: untagged legacy_true compatibility; original source independently confirmed q-default

shared_training.mode_override: Measured arm requires explicit --encoder-observation-mode deployment_measured --allow-encoder-observation-mode-change bound to the exact initial checkpoint. Legacy arm explicitly names legacy_true.

preflight_smoke.purpose: Actual GPU runner optimizer/normalizer resume, metadata save, export and strict reload; smoke outputs never seed or substitute for full arms.
checks: exact initial and output checkpoint SHA
tagged checkpoint and exported policy mode
preflight_smoke.continuation_gate: Full1000iteration arms remain pending root review of smoke receipts and this concrete plan.

evaluation.legacy_override: Explicit mode-change flag required when evaluating the legacy-trained checkpoint; label checkpoint_training_mode separately from active_observation_mode.
evaluation.nominal_mechanics_companion: Seed101 grid, preserving observation noise/latency/reset randomness.
reporting: paired actual startup arrays and command schedules
actual torso forces including light persistent support and sampled spans
evaluation.holdout_scope: Seed404 is the predeclared holdout for this study and is not used to select these arms; other class studies have used this seed.

native_followup.sensing: deployment_measured for every controller; training_by_controller only as a labeled attribution diagnostic
native_followup.scope: Repeat inspected adverse startup snapshots and full-hull materials through entry/walk/stops/exit/default without state resets, plus paired default-only and extended-zero controls already requested by parent.
native_followup.criterion: Report physical velocity, support, slip and settling; controller-clock completion alone is insufficient.

decision_rule: No automatic promotion. A sensing correction may improve deployment consistency without solving belly support or fallback stopping. Preserve negative cases and exact limitations; do not alter stance/rewards/limits/defaults to manufacture improvement.
